title: OFFER (One-Formula-Facilitates-Every-Relation) for Calculus
summary: The large number of calculus formulas makes learning calculus heavily memory-dependent and can scare away many students. Based on Issac Newton's idea of prediction, this paper shows that calculus students need to master only one critical formula: his proposition that, given boundary data, one can predict the interior and vice versa. We can treat other formulas as consequences of the formula for this proposition.
